Topics · Prayer and closeness to God

How near is God?

Nearer than the vein in your neck, with you wherever you are. A nearness that needs no distance crossed.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer[1528] to him than [his] jugular vein.

Translator's notes

[1528] In absolute knowledge of everything about him. "We" has also been interpreted to mean the angels who are mentioned in the following verse.

Quran · Qaf 50:16

Translation

You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.

Original · Hebrew

קָר֣וֹב אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וְֽכָל־מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אֱמֶֽת׃

the Psalms · 119:151

World English Bible

What is nearest to you? Perhaps your thoughts. The verse begins there: We know what the self whispers to itself, what you say to yourself and no one hears. Knowledge here comes before your speech. Then a precise picture: nearer than the jugular vein, the vessel carrying your life in your neck. Whoever is nearer than your own blood needs no one to inform Him, and you need no journey to reach Him. The distance you may feel is not a distance of place.

A question for you

Reading that God is nearer than your vein, what do you feel first?

If you sayPeace
ThenThen you have a share in this nearness. Carry it into your day.
If you sayUnease, since He knows everything
ThenAn honest feeling. But look: the One who knows everything in you still calls you. That has a question of its own.
If you sayI feel nothing
ThenThat is all right. The verse speaks of a fact it states, not a feeling. That feeling has a question too.

Part 2 of 3

﴿هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne.[1627] He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you[1628] wherever you are. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

Translator's notes

[1627] See footnotes to 2:19 and 7:54. [1628] In knowledge - observing and witnessing.

Quran · Al-Hadid 57:4

Translation

There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

Original · Ancient Greek

καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν κτίσις ἀφανὴς ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, πάντα δὲ γυμνὰ καὶ τετραχηλισμένα τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ, πρὸς ὃν ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος.

Hebrews · 4:13

World English Bible

A reader may object: how could the Maker of the whole universe be near me? The verse holds both in one sentence. It opens with heavens, earth and throne, in all their greatness, and moves without a break to: He is with you wherever you are. Greatness does not put Him far. Among people, whoever rises grows distant. The verse breaks that habit: the highest is the nearest. There is no place or hour in which you are a stranger to God.

A question for you

In what place in your life do you feel God is not there?

Part 3 of 3

﴿وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَشْرِقُ وَٱلْمَغْرِبُ ۚ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا۟ فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And to Allāh belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face[37] of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

Translator's notes

[37] See footnote to 2:19.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:115

Translation

For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering; for my name is great among the nations,” says Yahweh of Armies.

Original · Hebrew

כִּ֣י מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֜מֶשׁ וְעַד־מְבוֹא֗וֹ גָּד֤וֹל שְׁמִי֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וּבְכָל־מָק֗וֹם מֻקְטָ֥ר מֻגָּ֛שׁ לִשְׁמִ֖י וּמִנְחָ֣ה טְהוֹרָ֑ה כִּֽי־גָד֤וֹל שְׁמִי֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

Malachi · 1:11

World English Bible

If He is near everywhere, do you need a special place to reach Him? The verse says the east and the west belong to God, so wherever you turn, there is His face. No country, building or group holds Him. Places of prayer and a direction to face are gifts, not walls around Him. This holds for all people: no nation stands nearer because of where it is. Here the road back comes together: people may be scattered across every direction, yet the destination is one, and near to all.

A question for you

If God is this near, what keeps you away?

If you sayBusyness
ThenThen the distance is not in the road but in attention. One moment is enough to come back.
If you sayMy sins
ThenMany feel that, and the answer is very merciful.
If you sayI am not sure He is there
ThenAn honest place. The early questions were written for you, and they are still open.

The same in the other books

Translation

He searches out the deep and the heart. He has understanding of their secrets. For the Most High knows all knowledge. He sees the signs of the world. He declares the things that are past and the things that shall be, and reveals the traces of hidden things.

Original · Ancient Greek

Ἄβυσσον καὶ καρδίαν ἐξίχνευσε, καὶ ἐν πανουργεύμασιν αὐτῶν διενοήθη· ἔγνω γὰρ ὁ Κύριος πᾶσαν εἴδησιν, καὶ ἐνέβλεψεν εἰς σημεῖον αἰῶνος· ἀπαγγέλλων τὰ παρεληλυθότα καὶ ἐπεσόμενα, καὶ ἀποκαλύπτων ἴχνη ἀποκρύφων.

Sirach · 42:18-19

World English Bible

Translation

Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

Original · Hebrew

קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵ֑ב וְֽאֶת־דַּכְּאֵי־ר֥וּחַ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

the Psalms · 34:18

World English Bible

Translation

The whole [of god] sees, the whole perceives, the whole hears. But without effort he sets in motion all things by mind and thought.

Original · Ancient Greek

οὖλος ὁρᾷ, οὖλος δὲ νοεῖ, οὖλος δέ τ’ ἀκούει. ἀλλ’ ἀπάνευθε πόνοιο νόου φρενὶ πάντα κραδαίνει.

Greek thinkers · Xenophanes 2-3

Xenophanes (Fairbanks, 1898)

Translation

Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.

Original · Hebrew

דִּרְשׁ֥וּ יְהוָ֖ה בְּהִמָּצְא֑וֹ קְרָאֻ֖הוּ בִּֽהְיוֹת֥וֹ קָרֽוֹב׃

Isaiah · 55:6

World English Bible
